notes.title: We're Back — And So Is the Game Updates!
notes.content:
[p]✨Hey everyone![/p][p]It's been a long while since our last update — longer than we ever planned or wanted. The silence wasn't because we gave up or vanished. It was because real life hit us hard.[/p][p]One of our family members was diagnosed with cancer last year, and with a small dev team like ours, that meant stepping away from development completely to care for them and walk with them through the hardest parts of treatment. We didn’t want to make a vague post or half-hearted excuse at the time — we just needed to be present where it mattered most.[/p][p]But now, we’re back. Fully. And working like mad.[/p][p][/p][p]And we’ve got so much to show you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29239342/fec871a18ca059e8fc54c2f103a935959a8f233e.jpg"][/img]
✨ What's going on[/p][p]We didn’t waste the quiet. Between caretaking, we slowly chipped away at the next big update. And now that we’re moving at full speed again, we’re happy to say we have a [i]huge[/i] wave of content done already:[/p][list][*][p][b]New characters[/b] (some of whom we’re [i]really[/i] excited to introduce)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated and new sprites[/b] (yep, we gave some old faces to get themselves an updated outfits... and role)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Backgrounds, music, scenario[/b] — all pushing![/p][/*][*][p]And yes — plenty of surprises we’re keeping tucked away just a bit longer, so you can enjoy them when you don't even expect toWe’ll be posting regular updates again. The next devlog will include previews, screenshots, and behind-the-scenes tidbits. 

[b]We’re even thinking of doing a public tCoL art-stream if you’d like to hang out with us — let us know in comments![/b][/p][/*][/list][p]

✨To everyone who waited patiently — or impatiently (we get it) — thank you. Seriously. Your support means the world, even if you didn’t know what was going on behind the curtain. And to those just joining us: welcome to the ride.[/p][p]We’re so glad to be creating again. And trust us, the wait is about to pay off once we're ready to deliver! Stay tuned.
— Yours truly, The Dev Team

PS
Wow is it a Fire Boy Roui?! Yes it is! Say hi to his new side icon! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29239342/04174878908d9a3689b0a13e1ff398ce709e632d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29239342/4c3fda93a705805c441eeab3c63e620b06e77b97.jpg"][/img][/p]

On the occasion of the anniversary, we decided to please you and ourselves with a colorful scene of one of Roui’s birthdays. He spent it in Nouri together with Mermey and Laslo.

[i]"It was the warmest and most amazing day of late autumn, when sunlight suddenly poured through the clouds and drizzling rain. notes.title: 3d Act of tCoL will be released today!
notes.content:
Hello, guys!
We are thrilled to announce that the third act of the second chapter will be released today, despite our recent difficulties irl that stopped us from a quick and productive workflow. The second chapter will be updated for free, just download and update the game. There is no need for payment.  New adventures are waiting for you! 

What can you expect to find in the upcoming update?
New places to visit
- Beautiful night backgrounds
- New characters and animations.
- A brand new puzzle.
- There are multiple routes (the events will impact both the end of the second chapter and the future plot of the third chapter, so make a wise choice while playing).
- Roui will leave the Hill Camp! He is extremely happy to finally be free : D
- A secret location in the Slough (to find it, you need to go through the Slough plot again and pay attention to the buttons and tokens. :>)
- A secret character hidden in the Hill Camp. 
- And finally, fresh atmospheric soundtracks!

Just wait for the game to be released later today and enjoy~

< 3 Thank you for staying with us this whoooole time. Thanks for keeping your interest in tCoL. This means a lot to us, so we can keep going and making the content for you  < 3

notes.title: We've come with important news!
notes.content:
Hi guys! We've come with important news.
A lot has happened over the past few months with our team, friends and loved ones because of the tragic events that you have all heard about. It affects everybody and everything, it's a life change nobody ever wanted to happen, but here we are.
We also received COVID-19 as a small bonus, but have nearly recovered and are feeling good.

Despite this context, we do not intend to give up the development of the Crown of Leaves. It won't be easy to keep working on it since the local game development industry facing a lot of troubles, but with your support and some good vibes you're sending us, we'll definitely find a way to tell Roui's story without leaving it half-spoken.

At the moment, we are almost done with the [i]third act[/i] (it's a huge update for Chapter 2, and the story of it will get super intense, you'll love it!), however, we still have some work to do on the cutscenes and the puzzle + a few smaller tasks. We cannot speak of exact release dates, given what is going on irl. For now, we're just working and monitoring the situation. We remind you that the third act will be released as a free update to the second chapter, you won't have to buy anything to play it! 
The Chapter 3 will be a paid DLC, the price will be the same as for the Chapter 2. 


If you want to support the team, as well as to get access to the exclusive game materials, news, art, sprites, animations and music, you can also [url=https://www.patreon.com/lingrimm]support us on Pаtreоn[/url].  💫


Pls stay healthy and safe.
Love you all, tCoL team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 and 2.0.7
"Error" instead of the game texts hotfix (pls read!)
notes.content:
Guys! As you know, we have released a version for Linux as you requested, but Steam messed up the file names of this version that caused some problems. We are familiar with this bug, and we are currently working on a permanent solution. We cannot say precisely when we will fix it, but we try to do everything as quickly as possible. In the meantime, we have found a temporary solution so that the problem won't bother you. 
If you get the following error with the game - all texts in the game are replaced with "error" - you need to do the following:
- Try to verify the integrity of game files/reinstall the game
- If this does not help, you need to unpack these files https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AtTHRVeugYHGTLTIxAnz-QinZOQvQiuP/view?usp=sharing from the archive into the game folder. To do this, go to the Steam library, find The Crown of Leaves there, right-click on the title, and select Properties> Local Files> Browse. The game folder will be open. Unpack our archive into the opened folder. (If you have Linux, open the "assets" folder in the game folder and unpack the files in it).
Thank you all again for your patience and your support, love, and attention to the game!
Don't worry and stay with us! We will take care of everything very quickly! :>

notes.title: The 2nd Chapter is Now Live
notes.content:
Today is a big day - we finally got to the release of Chapter 2 of tCoL!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160540/The_Crown_of_Leaves_Chapter_2/

More lore, story, and dynamics await you this time. We started working on this chapter during the remaster, but we had the capability to get fully underway only at the beginning of 2020. With much thanks to our new team members, Dizir and Fjorge, we were able to devote more time to the script. We quickly found weak points in the plot and eliminated them, thanks to our professional editor Maria Mukharskaya (Grimm's mother, btw :>). Previously, we had to rewrite almost the entire story several times without her help, which affected the work's speed.

And yet, we still had to curb our ambitions a little; otherwise, we may have had to release Chapter 2 yet another year later. 
We would like to reiterate some information from previous news to discuss and ensure transparency about pricing:

[list]
[*] Chapter 1. Costs $ 4,99
[*] Chapter 2. Costs $ 1.99 Unlike the previous chapter, we divided this one into acts (there are 3 of them in the game) two of which will be released right now.
[*] Chapter 3 will be the last and the longest, as we think. It will also cost $ 1.99
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29239342/07e16984f136c6038dac7b8184b33697672412aa.png[/img]

Remember the [i]Immortal Horses[/i] add-on? This was a free content update to celebrate the remaster of the First Chapter. Similarly, Chapter 2 will be updated for free with the third act and you will be able to play it and see how everything in this chapter ends.

We apologize in advance for any bugs or errors you may encounter - alas, they inevitably appear even after the most intense beta tests. If you find one, we ask that you report it as soon as possible in the community center. We will be glad to help you!

Well, we definitely want to say our thanks to the Patrons' support, all those tons of kind words and inspiring fan creativity, as well as the vigilance of alpha and beta testers who did their best to make the project better.

A Few Words From Lins: As the project leader, I also thank the other members of the tCoL Chapter 2 team. We kept in contact almost 24/7, encouraging each other, discussing complex issues, and generating ideas. I would go to the ends of the Earth with you, guys.

DO NOTICE
It is the new engine so the old save files won't work! But there is the save-generator that will be working inside the game when you start the second Chapter!

notes.title: 2nd Chapter is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
The second chapter will be available for purchase in the store very soon! We're tidying up the game and brushing away the specks of dust at a fast pace.

For technical reasons, we cannot publish the game on March 27th - [b]only on Monday 29th[/b]. This is our mistake: we absolutely forgot that Steam doesn't allow weekend releases. Forgive us for this!

So, the first two Acts of the second Сhapter will be published on March 29th. We will release a free update for it a little later, which will add even more dialogues, illustrations, and the final third Act. We cannot set an exact date for this last update yet, since the team needs rest to be back to work with renewed vigor.

A note about the Crowns of Leaves OST: New mesmerizing tracks by Blacksmith will be added to the album! The album's price will not change, and if you have already purchased it, it will update automatically to include the new tracks. 

Important news for Linux users: We are having temporary difficulties creating a build for this OS, but we will be addressing this issue as soon as possible immediately following the release. Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: The 2nd Chapter Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The release date is already close, so it's time to summarize the work we have done!
The second chapter is almost finished. It turned out to be so big and detailed that we realized we simply would not be able to put the third act in order during the tests within the team in a timely manner.
But we would like for you could continue your journey with Roui as soon as possible and therefore we have decided to release the first two acts on March 27 and the third one closer to May. And take our word for it: even without the third act, the second chapter is longer than the previous one!

To clarify some information once more: the second chapter will be priced at $2.50. You will get the first two acts right away, and the third act will be released as a free update a couple of months later. Do we think this will spoil the impression? Of course not! In the third act, you will find much more dialogue (main-story and additional), cutscenes, as well as a quest from the last supporter cameo, Alain.

That's all for now! We look forward to delivering to you the next installment of The Crown of Leaves!

notes.title: Game Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello, guys! 

The time has come for news and a small report on the work we've done!
The First chapter has been completely moved from the RenPy engine to Game Maker Studio 2. We added a special module to the game for those who want to save on time: you can automatically simulate the completion of the First chapter before starting the Second one. Please note that only the main plot routes and character relationships (including the DLC) are built into the module, so if you still want to get those cookies you will have to go get them yourself. :)

We hoped for the best, of course, but the situation with the virus has not spared us, and it took a lot of our time and messed with our nerves. However, our team has kept and continues to keep working surprisingly well and remains united!

Let's go over some general points here:
[list]
[*] The Second chapter turned out to be 2.5-3 times longer than the First—even longer than we originally planned.
[*] This time we decided not to limit ourselves on anything, so we made lots of cutscenes and alternative dialogues (remember the decorous conversation between Roui and his aunt over a bottle of wine? Something like that), and gave more life to the sprites of the sahash characters with the expressive animation of their tails.
[*] The game will have 13 new characters, most of which will have their own quests.
[*] Morning and night versions of Hill Camp await you.
[*] The script is 100% finished (as well as its editing), the last part of it is being translated into English right now.
[*] 90% of the game content has already been drawn, but there are still some unfinished scenes and objects.
[*] _Blacksmith_ is still working on the OST for the game, adding themes for locations and characters.
[/list]

Also, in the near future we will conduct a beta test before publishing the final version of the game on Steam.

So, the Second chapter is almost ready! It would be great to be right in time by the end of December to present the continuation of Roui's story for the New Year, but you know how it's done—before you put the game on display, it must be properly debugged and polished. So we plan to finish it either by the end of January or by the end of February (at maximum).

Your positive comments, words of support and faith for this project give us strength and the desire to work even harder. We are infinitely grateful that you are looking forward to the game, and we will do our best to reward you for these long months of waiting. ♥

notes.title: What's New
notes.content:
So it's time for some good news about  the Crown of Leaves!

We've been thinking for a while after analyzing the situation with save-file bugs, which caused errors in the game code and awkward FPS stutters, and… We have finally moved from the free RenPy engine to a professional paid engine: Game Maker Studio 2, which is more suitable for our needs and the genre of "the Crown of Leaves". It has finally provided us with decent optimization and stable work. You'll be able to check this out when the game updates on Steam – which will happen at the same time with the release of Chapter Two. We have been busy with this for a long time, but most of the first chapter has already been transferred to the new engine, and everything  is going smoothly, so we've decided to share that news with you! 

Changing the game engine has entailed some changes within the team. Our previous coder, who had been working with the game’s modules –mold.ff– unfortunately left The Broken Horn. Now coding is entirely on the shoulders of our new programmer: Dizir. Such an arrangement allowed Lins (screenwriter and sprite artist) to relieve herself of coding responsibilities to focus more on the main plot of Chapter Two, and enabled her to finish it with all routes in under 3 months. The script’s word-count is approximately 37,300 words without additional dialogues, points of interest, item descriptions and the Mindscape's articles! Maria Mukharskaya, a professional literature editor and also Grimm's mother, has wholly joined our team.  She has been ruthlessly reading the text, making corrections, checking the logic and behaviour of the characters, and also discussing the further plot with us. It’s possible that her interest in this story played a huge role in a morale boost for us to pull ourselves together and continue our work.

And we've also got a professional translator, Lada Zainullina. Lada works fast -and this is important for us because we are going to publish "the Crown of Leaves" in two languages at the same time.
And finally, we now have an animator (!), Fjorge, who will make the character sprites  life like by animating their tails, and she also helps us work with the animatic.

To sum up:
► The main scenario for the second chapter is finished! Almost all sprites have already been drawn, and Grimm has completed 80% of all backgrounds. We still need to work on quests, additional dialogues, descriptions of points of interest and items, as well as to write articles for the Mindscape. Cutscenes are currently only in the sketch phase.

► Transferring the first chapter to the new engine is in full swing. With the help of Dizir, we don't have to work on coding by ourselves anymore, which means we don't have to waste our time on it.

► The release date is scheduled for the end of the 2020, according to our tradition - on the 27th (November or December). Perfectionists take time with a margin!

► The second chapter is almost twice as large as the first! 
P.S: What else would we like to tell you about the game? We've planned to create a small story in three chapters, but it seems like we have placed too many mysteries to the first chapter but haven't answered that much on them. Therefore, the second chapter will not only answer some of those questions that concern you, but will also begin to gradually lead you away from the Hill Camp, inviting you into a great adventure beyond its borders.  

That's all for today, folks! Don't forget to wash your hands. And thank you very much for being with us!
Let's keep strong, no matter what 2020 prepares for us.

notes.title: The new art and characters from the second chapter!
notes.content:
It's time to show you the new background and characters that we drew for the 2nd Chapter! We tried to pick the less spoiler-ish content for you so you won't have to worry about it.

So.
First of all, this is the cameo of our Patrons' characters, Akira08 and Yurokat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29239342/1c670a147528846cee647c676a73534401f237fd.png[/img]
> [i]Anoosh[/i] is an insidious guy from El-Balyama who makes a living by different types of fraud, in particular by showing everyone a booklet made of psychic paper, so everyone thinks something is written on it. Okay, we're joking, we just removed the contents of the brochure to avoid the spoilers. xP

> [i]Raakel[/i] is a half-breed, a gloomy Beylerian adventurer from the Magpies Brotherhood, a bounty hunter. She pretends to be a wandering merchant. Raakel was brought in Hill Camp by chance, and she fell in love with the local cuisine - it seems that Hill Camp dishes are always able to lift her spirits!
So you can try to guess what kind of quests are waiting for you, looking at these guys! (:

And here are the new background! Spooky! We drew the popcorn and soda cans to add a feeling of some abandoned cinema to this room. All that vending machines and the bird skulls, branches growing right from the walls... It's a strange place. But we won't tell you what's going on here anyway. xP

notes.title: The Crown of Leaves 2.0.1
Remaster: complete!
News!
notes.content:
August is almost over, autumn is coming, which means it's time to sum up the results for the past three months.
Alas, this summer turned out to be very difficult for our entire team. House fire, forced moving in and moving out from apartment to apartment, then the death of a team member's father, the funeral, and a ton of heartless paperwork after that. These events left their trail, knocked the team off our feet. But they didn't disrupt the work on the game, the remaster and the free add-on (aka DLC), which were mentioned earlier [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/604330/announcements/detail/1613891161345826007](see this post for more informaion)[/url]. We continued to work on the Crown, no matter what. Therefore, everything that we promised - is done, and it's currently going through a closed beta test. For now, we will wait a bit with the exact release date of the remaster and the DLC, because we want to fix all of the game bugs so they won't distract or annoy you during gameplay.
Thank you all for your attention and support. Wait for further news here.

notes.title: We are alive and we are working!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29239342/e66b9f2bd8103a8cdf60f7a75b9fbb4ee86e3785.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

It is time for some news. Many of you regularly ask what we are working on now, and when will the second chapter come out. Just as before, we won't name any specific dates - as our experience has already shown, naming dates that are too early doesn't affect the speed of our work, and only exhausts the team and drives us into stress. Of course, we aren't going to make the second chapter for another three years: the work now is going way faster because we learned a lot from making chapter one, but that's all we can say at this moment. Question: what takes so long? The answer is simple: the Story. It develops and changes, requires repeated brainstorming, thinking over characters, branches, concepts. We try not to miss a single detail, so that the story remains logical. Did we promise you that the characters and the world will respond to your actions in the game? We did - and this is how it's going to be :> 

Scenario to the second chapter is in progress, the first act is already finished. At the same time, we are working on all the mechanics available in the Crown, and even added something interesting. First, we moved from the old version of the game engine to the new one (which required various internal improvements, because at the early stages, due to our inexperience, we accidentally made everything very complicated). Secondly, we changed the resolution of the game from 1280x720 to 1920x1080. Thirdly, we reworked inventory and simplified craft mechanics. Fourthly, we listened to your feedback and made the Task Log, so it's much easier now to navigate Roui’s everyday life. And this is only a small part of what we have already done - you will see the rest by yourself and quite soon: we plan to release the remaster this summer.

notes.title: The Crown of Leaves - december news
notes.content:
Dear friends! Thank you very much for the feedback and comments. We are very pleased that the absolute majority of the players liked the Crown of Leaves, and we are happy that we could find a response in your hearts.
We also paid attention to the negative sides and wishes about the game, and we will certainly pay attenting to it in the future.
Separately, we want to mention the complaint about the shortness of the game. And we are giving you a hint here: in the Crown, there are three routes of playing. Your choices and relationships with characters - good and bad - affect them. Therefore, the entire first episode takes about 5 hours. The whole game, of course, will be several times longer.
And the good news: OSTs from the game will be available as soon as Steam allows us to add them. The same applies to the achievemts :)
Thank you once again for your support!

notes.title: Important news!
notes.content:
And it's a good one! 

Upon your request, we added Steam Cloud to the game, and now your saves are always with you :)

But there is an unexpected side effect: some users may have problems with the dialogues with one of the characters (Flynn). The game can crash. This only applies to old saves, so if you find an error, we recommend you to update the game or start it over. 

We apologize for the inconvenience, it won't happen again!

notes.title: Update r1.1.
The Crown of Leaves is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Finally, The Crown of Leaves has successfully went through the way from Greenlight to release! Now you can fully experience Roui's story and get to know him better, meet new characters, and also dive into the world of Shang-La and the riddles of the Hill Camp. Explore the environment, meet the hillcampers, collect items and fill up the Mindscape! 
We have tried to release several plot routes, and each of them affect the gameplay, but the real consequences of your choices are waiting for you in the next chapter. One of the main routes takes from 1 hour or more of playing time, the second -  3 hours or more. We highly recommend to go through both of the routes to get the full impression and experience the story from all sides. 
Alas, we couldn't put everything that we had planned in the first chapter. However, we already have sketches for the next one, and we're going to make everything come to life - and there will be more of the quest part. It is still difficult to say when the second chapter will be released, because first we need to rest, get ourselves together and gather the energy to keep working.  

This is our first game. There are only four people on our team, and game dev is a hobby for us, but we have found tremendous support among everyone. Thank you so much for being together for three years! Your advice and moral support helped our project to develop and become better. Special thanks to those who financed us on Patreon, as well as to the direct participants of the development who helped in creating the non-player characters - Vander and Alek (as well as others who will appear later in the game). 
Without all of you, Crown would never come to light!

notes.content:

So, many of you asked us about Trading cards on Steam. This is a rather interesting question if you aren't a developer, so we'll reveal some working secrets to you: as we're an indie team that went through Greenlight, we have to wait for Steam to remove the restrictions from our game (Steam calls this "Steam learning about this game"), and this probably depends on the number of reviews or downloads (?). No one really knows how long it can take, it's different for every game and Valve keeps their rules details in secret. But as soon as this happens, we will be happy to add Trading cards to the game.  We have already prepared them, drew badges and made 5 beautiful backgrounds for your profile. And about Emojis - we made them, too! ;)
The same applies to the Achievements. So all we can now is wait for Steam to finish its "learning".

[b]A[/b]: No. 

[b]Q[/b]: Will the game be ported to Mac? 
[b]A[/b]: Maybe! 

[b]Q[/b]: I want to translate your game into <some language>.

But for that time we do not want to rush things - we need to finish the work on the English translation first, otherwise, any edits will turn into hellish routine for the translators.

notes.title: New release date and stuff
notes.content:
Dear subscribers, watching the development of the "Crown"! 

We realized once again that we don’t have enough time to finish the game by the scheduled date (we postponed the release for March the last time). Fortunately, our enthusiasm has not gone anywhere, but, on the contrary, has only intensified, and thanks to our subscribers and patrons, we are increasingly devoting more time to working on the "Crown". 
Characters are becoming more detailed and elaborated, the game world is developing, new concepts and secrets are being added, and the plot is branching in the most unexpected ways even for us. Sometimes we have to rewrite the dialogues, and the part of the plot, which was finishes some months ago, disappears, and we are thrown back for a few steps. But now we understand more what we are doing and what is the exact story we write, so the end of the first chapter is just around the corner. Not in March, of course. But not in ten years. 

Of course, we could accelerate, and finish the game "as is", to make a re-release after. But the loose, hastily-written plot will surely cause your discontent, and we will immediately have a great desire to correct something and rewrite it, and this usually does not end well with anything. In the end, players become confused with the story. 

We decided to get rid of puzzles (this isn’t our strong side, and we don’t know why we even started this). Instead, we will concentrate on in-game riddles and simple ciphers, the solution of which will depend solely on your attentiveness. There will be plot riddles - they can be missed if you are completely focused on the main story and the lore - and there will be side and optional riddles that open the ways to secret branches. 
(For us, it was a big surprise that many people did not find cookie in the game. We can only advise you to look more closely at locations and do not forget to go back to where you were already – something may suddenly change! In the full version of the game, we plan to revitalize the environment, so it will react to your actions and change during the plot, so don’t miss it :>) 

-— 

Of course, there is a great risk to raise the bar once again and improve the game ONCE AGAIN - for example, to make more background animations and etc, etc, but then the game will be done in many years only. We are grateful to people for their feedback on the new demo, as well as their wishes, which help the game to develop. Unfortunately, we can not fulfil all the wishes, so we are only working with things people mention the most, like: mark the scanned tags in the locations, loop the background music, increase the speed of scrolling in the panoramas. 

-— 

The next approximate release date is October 2018. 
Also we were going to shorten the first episode a little to speed up the work. Accordingly, the price for it, too, will be less, and it will cost somewhere around 200 rubles (4-5 dollars). 

-— 

Keep following the Crown! To celebrate the new release date, we will soon share new concepts, backgrounds and sprites with you.

notes.title: DEMO 2.0 released
notes.content:
Hello! 
We are pleased to announce that the demo 2.0 is finished. We put everything together and added a lot of new, beautiful and interesting things (although something we have still reserved for the full version of the game). 

[list]
[*] The main innovation: inventory. Now you can take items from your inventory into your hand, use them, show them to characters and apply them. 

[*] The next thing you will definitely like: we have extended the story in the demo. Now you will find out what your decision will lead to in the Veglamb line. Cool? Cool. 

[*] We added three new locations, and the Hill camp definitely became bigger. They locations play their roles in the full version of the game, but for now you can walk in, look around and even meet someone new. 

[*] It seems that you have something new in Mindscape! Namely: the upgraded design and one new and very important article. Or not only one. 

[*] The first location is completely redrawn, and the second is upgrated and expanded.
[/list]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: The rescheduling of the release
notes.content:
Good day to all of you! 

We know that you are looking forward to the "Crown of the leaves" and are supporting us in all possible ways. This means a lot to us. When we work on the game, we think about you - about making it interesting to read the dialogs and to solve small in-game riddles, to enjoy colorful backgrounds and animated sprites. We listen to your opinion and improve what has already been done. We feel a great responsibility for your expectations, and we certainly don't want to disappoint you in any case. 

We had to postpone the game once, from spring until the autumn (almost winter, actually), and it looks like we have to do it again. The whole story is much deeper now. We finally thought over the details of the plot. We have added more branch lines and the plot is depended on the dialogues now. All this requires a lot of energy and attention, and we need more time to finish the game. 

Our small team is working hard on the script, but some events of the summer and autumn have knocked us down and reduced our productivity. Natalie De Corsar was going through a loss. Grimm had a serious surgery. But even during these periods, we didn't stop to draw and write. 

In any case, we assign the next approximate date of the release - [b]Spring 2018[/b]. We plan to finish the work in March, but we will see in the process and will keep you informed anyway. 

[b]ATTENTION[/b]! You all can check our progress, because we' are going to upload the new demo, as it's bigger and better now. The demo will be released by the New Year. You will see the updated inventory, improved design, and also you'll finally find out what happened to Rui after he dug (or cut, depending on your choice) the Veglamb! Also, you will get acquainted with some new characters, will look at the redesigned backgrounds and new animations!
